speed: n/a (locked framing on her; the camera descends with her so she holds one place in frame and all visible motion belongs to the dressing)
camera_height_m: on her own axis, below her, no floor datum and no horizon
angle: low, looking up the shaft past her
start_frame: Tight on her back as she drops through the tunnel mouth: the mouth still bright and close above her, the round earth walls just beginning to open out.
end_frame: The same framing with the tunnel mouth shrunk to a far speck: the fall slowed to nothing, skirts billowing and hair pulled up, the first pass — glazed cupboards and rows of stoneware jars — sliding steadily upward past her.
constraint_honoured: 'No horizon, no Dutch, no spinning camera. All the movement belongs to the dressing' — the frame holds her still and the shaft travels.
movement_note: Written for the model as a locked frame on her with the set moving: no camera-move term is given, which is the only stable way to generate an endless fall.
